title: Machito band personnel
summary: He names the trumpet, bass, piano, drum and sax players in the early band.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Who was playing in the band? Did you have steady musicians the whole time?
The musicians at that time was trumpet, Bobby Woodman.
Yeah, colored guy. Bass player, Julio Andino (phonetic). I had two, three piano players, Louie Varona, Gilberto [Frank] Ayala, Bellonás, Robert Alila, Joe Loco.
Joe Loco was in there, wasn't he?
Yeah. Then I had Roberto Nisto, drum and tymbale. First Alto (inaudible) Gene Johnson, colored dude, used to go with Cleop Hawkins (phonetic). Also was Freddy Escarute.

Freddy Escarite. Baritone player, Leslie Johnkings (phonetic). He's still in the band. He's the baritone. That was the sax section. And then I brought in another saxophone. Oh, José Madera (inaudible). Then Machito go to the
Well, before Machito go to the Army, I (inaudible).
